turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Who decided on the zero?
Spare me. Who decided, and on what evidence?
Almost unnervingly well-spoken. Every sentence perfectly built.
I didn't come here to be reviewed. The zero, Hale.
It's impressive. Do you ever just relax?
Not in this room. Either show me what you have or I'm walking down to the principal's office.
